question: When should recitation begin to make a woman tormented by love?
premises: Recitation begins from a watch of the night.
The practice is performed in this manner.
The woman becomes tormented by love.
inference: Beginning from a watch of the night, one should mutter thus to make the woman tormented by love.
plain_english: Beginning from a watch of the night, one should mutter thus to make the woman tormented by love.
